LanguageData.Strata_Seismograph.label: seismograph station
LanguageData.Strata_Seismograph.description: A powered listening post. When running it forecasts tremor risk, cave-in pressure under thick rock, and infestation weight on this floor — useful with canaries and the support overlay.
LanguageData.Strata_CollapseTrap.label: collapse trap
LanguageData.Strata_CollapseTrap.description: Charges under thick rock roof on an underground floor. When armed, a hostile stepping adjacent (or a manual trigger) drops a cave-in blob of ceiling — the trap is destroyed with the roof.
LanguageData.Strata_SoundDampeningWall.label: sound-dampening wall
LanguageData.Strata_SoundDampeningWall.description: A packed wall of felt, boards, and rubble. Cuts mining and machine noise that carries through rock and draws infestations. Place around drills and workshops underground.
